recommendation: Keep the commit. It fixes a current core ModelInfo Library surface while leaving authoritative ChargeItemDefinition resource maintenance in HL7/admin-incubator.

The active core Library/FHIR-ModelInfo source still had the stale root effectivePeriod and omitted the new applicability children.
